tool.name: Pre.cluster
tool.description: Remove sequences due to pyrosequencing errors
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@ #import re
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$fasta' fasta.dat && ln -s '$name' name.dat && ln -s '$group' group.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat") #if $name.is_of_type("mothur.names"): #silent $mothur_args.append("name=name.dat") #elif $name.is_of_type("mothur.count_table"): #silent $mothur_args.append("count=name.dat") #end if #if $group: #silent $mothur_args.append("group=group.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("diffs=" + str($diffs)) #silent $mothur_args.append("match=" + str($match)) #silent $mothur_args.append("mismatch=" + str($mismatch)) #silent $mothur_args.append("gapopen=" + str($gapopen)) #silent $mothur_args.append("gapextend=" + str($gapextend)) #silent $mothur_args.append("method=" + str($method_cond.method)) #silent $mothur_args.append("clump=" + str($clump)) #if $method_cond.method == "unoise": #silent $mothur_args.append("alpha=" + str($alpha)) #end if #if $method_cond.method == "tree": #silent $mothur_args.append("delta=" + str($delta)) #end if #if $method_cond.method == "deblur": #silent $mothur_args.append("error_rate=" + str($error_rate)) #silent $mothur_args.append("indel_prob=" + str($indel_prob)) #silent $mothur_args.append("max_indels=" + str($max_indels)) #if $error_dist: #silent $mothur_args.append("error_dist=" + str($error_dist)) #end if #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("processors='${GALAXY_SLOTS:-8}'")
echo 'pre.cluster(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log &&
cat fasta* &&
## without group information mothur writes a single map file and names it after ## the file it was given; rename it after the input dataset, so that the element ## of the map collection is recognisable #set $identifier = re.sub('[^\w\-\s\.]', '_', str($fasta.element_identifier)) #if not $identifier #set $identifier = 'fasta' #end if if [ -f fasta.precluster.map ]; then mv fasta.precluster.map 'fasta.precluster.${identifier}.map'; fi

param.label: name file or count table - Sequences Name reference
diffs - Number of mismatched bases to allow between sequences in a group (default 1)
gapopen - penalty for opening a gap (default -2)
gapextend - penalty for extending a gap (default -1)
clump - Which reads can be combined (default lessthan)
param.help: lessthan: merge reads with less abundance; lessthanequal: merge reads with less than or equal abundance

param.label: method - Preclustering algorithm (default simple)
param.help: simple: pseudo-single linkage (Huse) method; unoise: UNOISE error removal; tree: TreePrecluster; deblur: Deblur denoiser

param.label: alpha - value for the beta formula used in the unoise algorithm (default 2.0)
delta - amount of amplification between rounds of PCR, used in the tree algorithm (default 2.0)
error_rate - expected mean error rate of the data, as a fraction (default 0.005)
indel_prob - expected fraction of sequences with an insertion or deletion (default 0.01)
max_indels - maximum number of insertions or deletions expected in the data (default 3)
error_dist - fraction of sequences expected to have 0, 1, 2, ... errors

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The pre.cluster_ command implements a pseudo-single linkage algorithm with the goal of removing sequences that are likely due to pyrosequencing errors. The basic idea is that abundant sequences are more likely to generate erroneous sequences than rare sequences. With that in mind, the algorithm proceeds by ranking sequences in order of their abundance. Then we walk through the list of sequences looking for rarer sequences that are within some threshold of the original sequence. Those that are within the threshold are merged with the larger sequence. The original Huse method performs this task on a distance matrix, whereas we do it based on the original sequences. The advantage of our approach is that the algorithm works on aligned sequences instead of a distance matrix. This is advantageous because by pre-clustering you remove a large number of sequences making the distance calculation much faster.
.. _pre.cluster: https://mothur.org/wiki/pre.cluster/
**Notes**
mothur converts a name file into a count table before pre-clustering, so the sequence names are not returned as a separate dataset; they are part of the ``precluster.count_table`` dataset.
The map datasets are returned as the ``precluster.map`` collection: one element per group, named after the group, when a group file (or a count table that carries groups) is given, otherwise a single element named after the input fasta dataset. Their columns are ``ideal_seq``/``error_seq``/``abundance``/``diffs``/``sequence``.
